links.outcome: Reasons dermatologists rated ChatGPT-5 acne answers inappropriate, including overly technical language
links.effect: Of 75 responses, 65.3% were appropriate. Misleading information and overly technical language were the most frequent reasons for inappropriateness, followed by lack of risk disclosure.
links.quote: The most frequent reasons for inappropriateness were misleading information and overly technical language, followed by lack of risk disclosure.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates ChatGPT responses to frequently asked acne questions using expert dermatologist ratings, but does not compare or test specific deployment practices or safeguards.
